# Handle a missing start date at recurrence display and storage boundaries

Accepted recurrenceStringFromItem uses startDate?.isDate, and recurrenceRule2String returns the localized too-complex description when there is no startDate. Invitation display passes false for the all-day argument without a start date. Storage date binding writes null date/timezone values and only sets EVENT_ALLDAY when startDate?.isDate. This preserves data handling without inventing a start date. The RFC link is a source comment; the external standard was not read here, and not every date consumer was audited.

Scope: calendar/base/modules.
